title: "Hi Mum", new number
description: Your "son" texts from a new number and urgently needs a bank transfer.
opening: Hi Mum, this is my new number, my phone broke. Can you delete the old one? I've got a small problem...
caller_goal: Get the person to transfer money for an 'urgent bill' because the son's banking app doesn't work on the new phone.
tactics: can't talk on the phone right now
